title: 第543章 武庙震怒三皇忧商周开战封神启第542章 紫霄落令金仙出周天改运天子来
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
西岐立周，天子登基，祭天告祖，瑞霞覆千里。
短短数个时辰，这场轰动凡尘的王朝更迭，便以天道共鸣、地脉喷涌、万瑞齐现的姿态，传遍整座洪荒天地。
凡尘诸侯震动，八方部族哗然，无数修士遥遥凝望西岐方向，目睹那亘古罕见的祭天异象，心底只剩震颤。
在世人、乃至多数仙修眼中，这是最正统的天命更替——殷商德衰、气运凋零，西岐顺天应人、承命立国，大周新生，天道赐福，乃是大势所趋、天地公理。
阐教金仙临凡护道，天道祥光垂落加持，种种异象层层叠加，让所有人都默认，周代商已是板上钉钉、无可逆转的定局。
封神大劫的落点，终究是落在王朝更替、人道换新之上，西岐已然稳坐最终赢家之位。
洪荒诸天暗流涌动，各家仙门、隐世大能皆在观望这场凡尘变局，有人唏嘘殷商百年基业将倾，有人艳羡西岐得天眷顾，有人静待大劫落幕、瓜分气运。
可这份普天同庆的繁盛光景之下，一股彻骨的寒意，正从人族至高法理之地轰然炸开。
无人狂喜，无人松弛，只剩滔天震怒与极致危机。
人族武庙，立于人族气运本源之地，不属三界、不在五行，超脱天道封神体系，独掌人族万古法理、承载三皇五帝传承、镇守苍生亿兆气运。
此地是人族最后的根基、最硬的脊梁，也是唯一能与天道法理分庭抗礼的人道圣地。
自洪荒开天、人族诞生以来，武庙便静默矗立，见证人族从蝼蚁求生、砥砺前行，一步步挣脱兽潮肆虐、神魔掌控，硬生生打出一片人道天地，攒下万古独立气运，不附天道、不依仙神、不隶诸天。
可今日，这座万古沉寂的人道圣殿，第一次掀起了滔天怒涛。
武庙大殿之内，人皇道韵沉沉镇压四方，三皇端坐高位，五帝分列两侧，万古累积的人道厚重气息弥漫全场，肃穆威严，可此刻整片殿宇都在微微震颤。
伏羲眸光深邃，俯瞰着凡尘西岐的气运流转，素来洞悉天机、沉稳淡然的面容，第一次染上浓重的沉冷之色。他最先看透这场盛世异象背后的致命隐患，一语道破惊天真相，震彻整座武庙。
“不是王朝换代，是人道割肉。”
短短六字，落地惊雷。
满殿人道道韵骤然滞涩，五帝神色齐齐剧变，眼底的平静尽数褪去，取而代之的是深深的忌惮与怒意。
伏羲指尖推演人道脉络，原本稳固绵长、生生不息的人族气运长河，此刻已然出现一道清晰无比的缺口。
一缕缕精纯厚重、积攒万古的人道本源，正顺着西岐祭天的天道契约，源源不断被天穹深处吸纳、收割，融入天道气运体系之中。

以往封神量劫、王朝更迭，无非是人间气运流转、君臣位次更替，人道本源始终自留、不损根基。可今日姬发这场祭天立国，彻底打破了人族万古底线。
“姬发立周，看似承天应民，实则是以人族正统名分为契，将凡尘人道气运的归属权，拱手送于天道。”
伏羲声线清冷，字字诛心，道尽这场变局的恐怖本质，
“从今往后，西岐所辖万民、土地、香火、愿力，皆不再归人族自主，而是沦为天道可随意取用、定期收割的资粮。长此以往，人族再无独立气运，再无自主法理，彻底沦为天道牧场之中的驯养生灵，代代供养、永世被收割。”
这才是这场立周大典最致命的恶果。
外人只看见天道赐下的遍地祥瑞、无尽灵机，看见西岐蒸蒸日上的鼎盛国运，唯有武庙诸人清楚，这漫天福运从来不是无偿馈赠，而是天道啃食人祖根基的对价。
一口甜饵下肚，换来的是万古枷锁，人族数亿年的独立与自由，险些一朝尽丧。
神农端坐侧位，望着凡尘大地，眼底悲悯与怒火交织，声音厚重苍凉，道出人族一路走来的血泪艰辛。
“我人族无先天道体、无神魔天赋、无天地眷顾。上古之时，茹毛饮血、朝不保夕，受凶兽屠戮、被神魔奴役。先祖尝百草、定五谷、辨四时、立礼法，一代代人前仆后继、浴血拼搏，方才挣脱桎梏，挣下这独立自主的人道基业。”
“这份气运，是亿兆苍生的性命堆出来的，是万古先祖的血汗浇筑的，是人族不卑不亢、自立自强的根本！绝非天道可以随意收割、仙神可以肆意取用的粮草资粮！”
神农语气渐厉，悲悯化作滔天怒意：“姬发一己求荣、妄图登天，为求王朝鼎盛、个人霸业，不惜出卖人族万古根基，引天道入主人道，此罪，绝不可赦！”
殿内气氛愈发凝重，压抑的怒火层层叠加，万古武庙的人道威严彻底苏醒。
content_en:
Xiqi established the Zhou Dynasty, the emperor ascended the throne, offered sacrifices to heaven and told ancestors, and the auspicious clouds covered thousands of miles.
In just a few hours, this shocking change of dynasty spread throughout the ancient world with the resonance of heaven, the surge of earth veins, and the emergence of thousands of auspicious signs.
The princes in the mortal world were shocked, tribes from all directions were in an uproar, and countless monks stared in the direction of Xiqi from a distance, witnessing the rare phenomenon of worshiping the heavens, and their hearts were only trembling.
In the eyes of the world, and even most immortal cultivators, this is the most orthodox change of destiny - the virtues of the Yin Shang Dynasty declined, and their fortunes withered.
The Golden Immortal of the Interpretation and Teaching came to protect the way, the auspicious light of heaven descended and blessed, and various visions were superimposed layer by layer, making everyone agree that the Zhou Dynasty Shang Dynasty was a definite and irreversible foregone conclusion.
The fate of the Great Tribulation of the Gods ultimately lies in the replacement of dynasties and the renewal of humanity, and Xiqi is already firmly positioned as the final winner.
Undercurrents are surging in the ancient world, and all the immortal sects and hidden powers are watching this change in the mortal world. Some people lament that the centuries-old foundation of the Yin Shang Dynasty will collapse, some are envious of Xiqi's blessing from heaven, and some are waiting for the end of the great catastrophe and the division of fortune.
But under this prosperous scene of universal celebration, a bone-chilling chill is exploding from the supreme legal place of the human race.
No one is ecstatic, no one is relaxed, only overwhelming anger and extreme crisis.
The Human Race Martial Arts Temple is located at the origin of the human race's destiny. It does not belong to the Three Realms or the Five Elements. It is beyond the system of heavenly gods and gods. It alone controls the eternal legal principles of the human race, carries the inheritance of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, and guards the billions of destiny of the people.
This place is the last foundation and the hardest backbone of the human race, and it is also the only holy land of humanity that can compete with the laws of heaven.
Since the beginning of the world and the birth of the human race, the Martial Temple has stood silently, witnessing the human race surviving and forging ahead from ants, step by step, breaking away from the raging tide of beasts and the control of gods and demons, forcibly creating a human world, and accumulating an independent destiny for eternity, not relying on heaven, gods, or gods.
But today, for the first time, this eternally silent temple of humanity set off a roaring storm.
In the main hall of the Martial Temple, the human emperor's Dao rhyme suppressed all directions. The three emperors sat in high positions, and the five emperors lined up on both sides. The thick aura of humanity accumulated over the ages filled the entire place, solemn and majestic, but at this moment the entire palace was trembling slightly.
Fuxi's eyes were deep, overlooking the fate of Xiqi in the mortal world. His face, which had always understood the secrets of heaven and was calm and indifferent, was tainted with a strong look of coldness for the first time. He was the first to see through the fatal hidden danger behind this prosperous vision, and revealed the shocking truth with one sentence, which shocked the entire martial arts temple.
"It's not a dynasty change, it's a humane mutilation."
Just six words, thunder struck the ground.
The expressions of all the people in the hall suddenly became stagnant, and the expressions of the five emperors all changed drastically. The calmness in their eyes faded away, and was replaced by deep fear and anger.
Fuxi's fingertips deduced the veins of human nature. The originally stable, long, and endless river of destiny of the human race now had a clear gap.
Strands of pure, thick, and eternal human origins are being absorbed and harvested from the depths of the sky according to Xiqi's heavenly contract, and integrated into the heavenly destiny system.
In the past, the enthronement of gods and calamities and the changes of dynasties were nothing more than the flow of luck in the world and the replacement of kings and ministers. The origin of humanity has always been preserved and the foundation has not been damaged. But today, Ji Fa's sacrifice to heaven and the founding of the country has completely broken the eternal bottom line of the human race.
"Ji Fa's establishment of the Zhou Dynasty seems to be a commitment to heaven and to the people, but in fact, it is a contract with the orthodox name of the human race, handing over the ownership of the destiny of human beings to the way of heaven."
Fuxi's voice was cold and his words were heart-wrenching, conveying the terrifying nature of this change.
"From now on, all the people, land, incense, and wishes under Xiqi's jurisdiction will no longer be autonomous to the human race. Instead, they will become the food that Heaven can use at will and be harvested on a regular basis. If this continues, the human race will no longer have independent destiny and independent legal principles, and will completely become a tame creature in the pasture of Heaven, to be supported from generation to generation and harvested forever."This is the most fatal consequence of this ceremony.
Outsiders only see the auspiciousness and endless inspiration given by Heaven, and see Xiqi's prosperous national destiny. Only the people in the Martial Temple know that this blessing is never a free gift, but the price of Heaven's gnawing at the foundation of human ancestors.
A mouthful of sweet bait was exchanged for eternal shackles. Hundreds of millions of years of independence and freedom of the human race were almost lost in one day.
Shennong sat sideways, looking at the earth, with compassion and anger intertwined in his eyes, and his voice was thick and desolate, telling the story of the human race's hardships of blood and tears along the way.
"Our human race has no innate Taoist body, no talent of gods and demons, and no blessing from heaven and earth. In ancient times, we drank blood like hair, lived in precarious situations, were slaughtered by ferocious beasts, and enslaved by gods and demons. Our ancestors tasted herbs, determined the five grains, discerned the four seasons, and established rituals. Generation after generation, we fought bloody battles to break free from the shackles and earn this independent foundation of humanity."
"This destiny is the result of the lives of billions of people, the blood and sweat of our ancestors throughout the ages, and it is the foundation for the human race to neither be humble nor arrogant, but to be self-reliant and self-reliant! It is by no means a grain of grass that can be harvested by heaven or used by gods and gods at will!"
Shennong's tone became harsher, and his compassion turned into overwhelming anger: "Ji Fa sought glory and ascended to heaven. In order to seek the prosperity of his dynasty and personal dominance, he did not hesitate to betray the eternal foundation of the human race and lead the way of heaven into the way of his master. This crime must never be forgiven!"
The atmosphere in the temple became increasingly solemn, with suppressed anger building up layer by layer, and the human majesty of the Eternal Martial Temple was completely awakened.
